name: ng18_11_bridge_needs_straight_drag
description: A river: vertex columns 9..12 at 200 m under a 250 m sea, so cells x = 8..12 have water. One bridge type with a minimum span of 2 (the bridge internals are the host's, NG2). Road (0, 10) -> (20, 16), snap off: dragged count 21 > straight count 14, so no bridge; CheckForGoodTerrain cuts at the first wet regular step (8) with 0xF0000001 and the run is refused. Snapped straight, (0, 10) -> (20, 10): at step 8 (wet), start 7, end 13 (the first dry step), 13 < v - 1 and < the straight count 21; span 6 > 3 and the minimum span 2 <= 7: steps 7..13 become kind 1 and no pass cuts.
